'''''Vitis monticola''''', commonly known as '''mountain grape''', or '''sweet mountain grape''', is a [[North America]]n species of wild [[grape]] native to [[Texas]]. It is important to grape growers for its resistance to [[drought]]; a quality exploited both genetically in [[Hybrid (biology)#Hybrid plants|hybridization]], and in [[grafting]].<ref name=grin/>
